Implemented Signal Drift in [src/main.ts](/workspace/src/main.ts) with responsive presentation in [src/style.css](/workspace/src/style.css).

Included:
- Three.js 3D relay course, hazards, pickups, charge drain, ordered relays, extraction win, loss, restart
- Keyboard, pointer-drag, and phone touch steering
- HUD, title/start screen, pause-on-visibility, motion/camera feedback
- Live `window.__AETHERPLAY__` contract
- No runtime network calls
